From Empress · Price: it needs a touch to the target's blood (an open wound).

Theme Affliction

  • 1: 1 action: plant a parasite in a wounded creature: it bites as it burrows in for @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[piercing]] damage (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}), and on a failure it takes hold. It's @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 2} on a critical failure) for 1 minute and can't reduce it below 1 while the parasite lives, and the parasite feeds: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[force]] persistent bleed damage; a @Check[medicine|against:stand] check against your stand DC (2 actions) cuts it out.
  • 5: The parasite grows into a talking face: the target takes –2 to Deception and Stealth and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 1} while it lives. The parasite's feeding bleed equals @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[force]]. Surge: the parasite attacks: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[piercing]] (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}), and the target can't Recover from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened}.
  • 9: No change.
  • 13: Two parasites at once. The parasites have grown: a failure makes the target @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 2} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 3} on a critical failure), it can't reduce it below 2 while the parasite lives, and the parasite also makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{enfeebled 2}.
  • 17: No change.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.ZqKwhHea4guWNVnD]{Effect: Talking Parasite}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
